question: Does multiplying same completed UTC-day BTCUSDT close by Coinbase USDT-USD close materially change original post-2022 BUY price gates?
theory: USDT/USD drift changes the USD unit of BTCUSDT. A persistent unit move can alter a rolling price gate only near that gate; this is signal attribution, not a cross-venue premium prediction or a claim USD is better for a USDT wallet.

inputs.coinbase_rows: history/daily.json products USDT-USD; [time_s,low,high,open,close,base_volume]; use only close
inputs.original_model: spotquant/model.py at source commit 74bd6e035e36531c517029077c1a9e2e5ec44516; price-gate constants unchanged

scope.cohort: All distinct settled original BUY allocation rows with signal_ms >= 2022-01-01T00:00:00Z, inside same-day complete BTCUSDT and USDT-USD range; no search of SELL, non-BUY, premiums or candidate entries.
scope.order: Ascending signal_ms; first three BUY rows with 400 consecutive converted closes are the 2-3 required original reconstruction examples. Stop and investigate source mismatch before calculating divergences.
scope.availability: Use completed bar signal_ms only if signal_ms + 86400000 + 60000 <= earliest original accepted BUY decision_ms for that signal. No current-day FX. This 60-second modeled close lag is a conditional development check; 2026 receipts do not prove historical Coinbase data actually available then.
scope.warmup: Require 400 consecutive same-day complete converted close rows ending at signal_ms for full price-branch screen, including 30/40/50, 252 and 400. Count actual rows. Earlier BUY rows remain insufficient; never splice unconverted BTCUSDT into a USD rolling window.
scope.no_selection: No date, SMA, quote, or effect-size adjustment after screen; all eligible original BUY rows reported, including zero differences.

computation.usd_price: Decimal(Binance BTCUSDT close) * Decimal(Coinbase USDT-USD close) on exactly the same UTC-day bucket. USDT/USD is USD per USDT, so multiply, never invert.
computation.original_reconstruction: Replay both units using the original Model rolling formulas: close > SMA for 30/40/50, 2 consecutive bullish closes, close >= 0.5*max(last 252 closes), extension close >=1.61*SMA; 400-day cap reversal/handoff prerequisites with their original .11/.07/.50/.11 constants. For 3 examples, original-unit price gates, trigger_close and approved BUY sleeves must agree with original ledger before comparison.
computation.ownership_limit: Reuse original BUY allocations, approved sleeves, decision time, and unchanged ownership/need_reset from original ledger. Price-only attribution cannot prove hypothetical full account action or new BUY for sleeves absent from the original order.
computation.affected_quote: For each approved original BUY sleeve whose USD close-based ordinary entry gate fails, attribute its equal-weight fraction of that order's original quoteOrderQty. No synthetic order or cash effect.
computation.material_screen: Proceed toward a separately frozen account comparison only if at least 2 distinct original BUY groups in at least 2 calendar years change approved-sleeve eligibility and affected quote is at least 5% of all fully eligible original BUY quote. Otherwise close this route. Report exact component differences even when screen fails.
computation.valuation_sensitivity: Optional read-only same-day USD value: original projection daily equity_usdt times Coinbase USDT-USD close, contrasted with its old fx=1 USD proxy. This is a valuation sensitivity, not new account cash flow, return proof, or true available historical mark.

next_gate: Only if material screen passes and historical input availability is actually authenticated, freeze one minimal account variant before running it. Require original vs variant vs simple BTC hold/cash, matched start dates, funds, fees, fill ownership, USD/USDT valuation and participation; no account run on this screening specification alone.
